about: Code the Word verse map. Each category matches a kind of code. 'starts_with' matches the first word of the line (structure); 'keywords' match words inside function/class names. Categories are checked top to bottom, first match wins. Add verses freely — they rotate.

verses.text: Confess your faults one to another, and pray one for another, that ye may be healed. The effectual fervent prayer of a righteous man availeth much.
verses.note: Every tap here is someone praying for someone else.

verses.text: Be careful for nothing; but in every thing by prayer and supplication with thanksgiving let your requests be made known unto God.
verses.note: Every request, made known.

verses.text: If we confess our sins, he is faithful and just to forgive us our sins, and to cleanse us from all unrighteousness.
verses.note: Errors caught and handled, not hidden. Confession is the catch block of the soul.

verses.text: As far as the east is from the west, so far hath he removed our transgressions from us.
verses.note: What is caught here is dealt with, not carried forward.

verses.text: And let us not be weary in well doing: for in due season we shall reap, if we faint not.
verses.note: The same faithful work, again and again, until the harvest.

verses.text: It is of the LORD's mercies that we are not consumed, because his compassions fail not. They are new every morning: great is thy faithfulness.
verses.note: New every morning, new every pass.

verses.text: In the beginning God created the heaven and the earth.
verses.note: Everything that runs had a first line.

verses.text: In the beginning was the Word, and the Word was with God, and the Word was God.
verses.note: Before the code, the Word.

verses.text: I have fought a good fight, I have finished my course, I have kept the faith:
verses.note: Finish clean. Release what you held.

verses.text: I am the door: by me if any man enter in, he shall be saved, and shall go in and out, and find pasture.
verses.note: There is one true door. Guard this one well.

verses.text: The LORD shall preserve thy going out and thy coming in from this time forth, and even for evermore.
verses.note: Every way in and every way out is kept.

verses.text: Prove all things; hold fast that which is good.
verses.note: Test everything. Keep what holds.

verses.text: Ask, and it shall be given you; seek, and ye shall find; knock, and it shall be opened unto you:
verses.note: Every query is an asking.

verses.text: And ye shall seek me, and find me, when ye shall search for me with all your heart.
verses.note: Search with the whole heart.

verses.text: Thy word is a lamp unto my feet, and a light unto my path.
verses.note: Reading the input lights the way for everything after.

verses.text: All scripture is given by inspiration of God, and is profitable for doctrine, for reproof, for correction, for instruction in righteousness:
verses.note: What is read in shapes everything after.

verses.text: Thy word have I hid in mine heart, that I might not sin against thee.
verses.note: What is stored well is there when it is needed.

verses.text: But lay up for yourselves treasures in heaven, where neither moth nor rust doth corrupt, and where thieves do not break through nor steal:
verses.note: Store what lasts.

verses.text: As far as the east is from the west, so far hath he removed our transgressions from us.
verses.note: Removed completely, not just hidden.

verses.text: Create in me a clean heart, O God; and renew a right spirit within me.
verses.note: Clear out the old to make room for the new.

verses.text: And be not conformed to this world: but be ye transformed by the renewing of your mind, that ye may prove what is that good, and acceptable, and perfect, will of God.
verses.note: Input goes in one shape and comes out renewed.

verses.text: And he said unto them, Go ye into all the world, and preach the gospel to every creature.
verses.note: Every message sent out is a small going-forth.

verses.text: So shall my word be that goeth forth out of my mouth: it shall not return unto me void, but it shall accomplish that which I please, and it shall prosper in the thing whereto I sent it.
verses.note: What is sent with purpose accomplishes it.

verses.text: Behold, I stand at the door, and knock: if any man hear my voice, and open the door, I will come in to him, and will sup with him, and he with me.
verses.note: A request knocks. Someone has to answer.

verses.text: For where two or three are gathered together in my name, there am I in the midst of them.
verses.note: Every connection is a gathering.

verses.text: And it shall come to pass, that before they call, I will answer; and while they are yet speaking, I will hear.
verses.note: A good server listens before the call ends.

verses.text: But they that wait upon the LORD shall renew their strength; they shall mount up with wings as eagles; they shall run, and not be weary; and they shall walk, and not faint.
verses.note: Waiting is not idle. It is renewal.

verses.text: Let your light so shine before men, that they may see your good works, and glorify your Father which is in heaven.
verses.note: What is rendered here is seen by others.

verses.text: Ye are the light of the world. A city that is set on an hill cannot be hid.
verses.note: What is on the screen cannot be hid.

verses.text: So teach us to number our days, that we may apply our hearts unto wisdom.
verses.note: Count carefully. The numbers mean something.

verses.text: And if one prevail against him, two shall withstand him; and a threefold cord is not quickly broken.
verses.note: Joined together, stronger.

verses.text: And the LORD answered me, and said, Write the vision, and make it plain upon tables, that he may run that readeth it.
verses.note: Write it plainly so the one who comes after can run with it.

verses.text: So shall my word be that goeth forth out of my mouth: it shall not return unto me void, but it shall accomplish that which I please, and it shall prosper in the thing whereto I sent it.
verses.note: Nothing returns void.

verses.text: Give, and it shall be given unto you; good measure, pressed down, and shaken together, and running over, shall men give into your bosom. For with the same measure that ye mete withal it shall be measured to you again.
verses.note: What goes in shapes what comes back.

verses.text: For as the body is one, and hath many members, and all the members of that one body, being many, are one body: so also is Christ.
verses.note: Many members, one body. Every method has its part.

verses.text: For other foundation can no man lay than that is laid, which is Jesus Christ.
verses.note: Build on the right foundation.

fallback.text: In the beginning was the Word, and the Word was with God, and the Word was God.
Trust in the LORD with all thine heart; and lean not unto thine own understanding.
For God so loved the world, that he gave his only begotten Son, that whosoever believeth in him should not perish, but have everlasting life.
He hath shewed thee, O man, what is good; and what doth the LORD require of thee, but to do justly, and to love mercy, and to walk humbly with thy God?
And whatsoever ye do, do it heartily, as to the Lord, and not unto men;
fallback.note: Write every line as if for Him.

fallback.text: I can do all things through Christ which strengtheneth me.
Commit thy works unto the LORD, and thy thoughts shall be established.
